NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Thorbis uses Bluetooth to connect to supported card readers for in-person payments.
NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Thorbis uses your location to show your position on the schedule map and verify where in-person card payments occur.
NSCameraUsageDescription: Thorbis uses the camera to add job photos, such as before and after shots, to the job you are working on.
NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Thorbis uses Face ID so only you can leave customer mode after handing your device to a customer.
